item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-c0870a4c1b1f9d6f","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"On 27 February 2022, Scholz stated that Germany had decided to supply Ukraine with weapons for its defence and had agreed with EU and G7 partners on extensive sanctions against Russian banks, state businesses, technology exports, oligarchs, and officials.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.8","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Outside the target period; establishes the policy basis carried into 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz stated and presented these decisions as Federal Government policy.","limitations":["The source is a policy statement and does not independently establish implementation quality or effects in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c0870a4c1b1f9d6f","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz stated that Germany had reinforced NATO's eastern allies by deploying additional troops to Lithuania, enhancing air policing in Romania, contributing to a new NATO unit in Slovakia, and increasing naval security activity.","question_ids":["2B.8","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Outside the target period; describes commitments and deployments relevant to the subsequent 2023 posture.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz attributed the deployments to the Federal Government and Bundeswehr.","limitations":["The source does not provide independent verification of proportionality, costs, or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c0870a4c1b1f9d6f","start_unit":9,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"Scholz announced a €100 billion special fund for the Bundeswehr, a goal of spending more than 2% of GDP on defence annually, investment in aircraft, ships, personnel and technology, and resilience measures against cyberattacks, disinformation, critical-infrastructure attacks, and communications disruption.","question_ids":["1B.9","2B.8","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Outside the target period; a stated programme with implementation implications for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz announced the fund, spending target, procurement priorities, and resilience objectives.","limitations":["The statement does not establish that the announced resources were fully executed or that the measures reduced risk."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c0870a4c1b1f9d6f","start_unit":10,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"Scholz stated that Germany would reduce dependence on individual energy suppliers by expanding gas storage options, acquiring additional gas on world markets, rapidly building LNG terminals at Brunsbüttel and Wilhelmshaven, and providing relief for high energy prices through subsidies and tax measures.","question_ids":["5B.9","6B.6","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Outside the target period; establishes measures whose implementation extended into 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz described these as Federal Government decisions and relief measures.","limitations":["The source does not quantify implementation, distributional effects, or later correction."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c4e72005cc34c2d2","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"In November 2022, Scholz said Germany would support Ukraine for as long as necessary with economic, financial, humanitarian, reconstruction, and military assistance; he specified artillery and air-defence deliveries and training of a Ukrainian brigade of up to 5,000 soldiers in Germany under an EU mission.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.8","8B.3","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Outside the target period; describes commitments continuing into 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz stated the policy and described German military training and assistance.","limitations":["The speech does not independently assess safeguards, abuse monitoring, or effectiveness."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c4e72005cc34c2d2","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz stated that Germany would reserve up to 17,000 soldiers for the NATO Response Force through 2024, again lead NATO's rapid-response force in 2023, permanently reinforce its Lithuania battlegroup, assign a Bundeswehr brigade to Lithuania, and provide a division and air and naval forces to NATO.","question_ids":["2B.8","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The source includes explicit 2023 commitments but was delivered in 2022.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz presented the force commitments as Federal Government and Bundeswehr policy.","limitations":["The source does not independently verify readiness, execution, or proportionality."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c4e72005cc34c2d2","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany took Russian nuclear rhetoric seriously while insisting that a nuclear war must never occur; he also endorsed continued NATO nuclear deterrence and announced procurement of F-35 aircraft for Germany's future contribution to NATO nuclear sharing.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.5","1B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Outside the target period; describes the nuclear-risk posture inherited during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz stated the deterrence and procurement policy.","limitations":["The source does not document command-and-control, arms-control, or accident-prevention safeguards."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c4e72005cc34c2d2","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany was preparing its first National Security Strategy based on integrated security, stronger crisis prevention and response, protection against cyberattacks and disinformation, and protection of critical infrastructure and diversified supply chains.","question_ids":["1B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Outside the target period; the programme was later formalized in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz described the strategy as a Federal Government project.","limitations":["At this point the strategy was still being prepared, so implementation and review were not yet shown."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5733b3d01d47c51b","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"On 22 June 2023, Scholz stated that Germany had adopted its first National Security Strategy, centered on protecting citizens from all threats, supporting Ukraine, strengthening NATO-area defence, building a geopolitically capable Europe, and coordinating federal, state, and municipal crisis capacities.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz attributed adoption and implementation of the strategy to his government.","limitations":["The speech gives no independent evaluation of execution or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5733b3d01d47c51b","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Scholz reported that Germany's budget committee had approved procurement of Arrow 3 and IRIS-T air-defence systems as part of the European Sky Shield Initiative.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.3","1B.8","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz reported the committee approval and linked it to German-led European air-defence cooperation.","limitations":["The source does not establish delivery, operational performance, or safety oversight."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5733b3d01d47c51b","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Scholz stated that German civilian and military aid to Ukraine since the start of the war totaled €16.8 billion, making Germany the second-largest supporter after the United States, and that a recent €2.7 billion package focused on armoured vehicles, air defence, artillery, and ammunition.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.8","8B.3","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023, though the cumulative figure covers the period since 2022.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz presented the amounts and allocation as German government policy.","limitations":["The source does not independently verify the amounts, end use, civilian-harm monitoring, or battlefield effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5733b3d01d47c51b","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany would begin spending 2% of GDP on defence from 2024, use the Bundeswehr special fund for effective procurement, and pursue targets of making the Bundeswehr a guarantor of conventional European defence and expanding Europe's defence-technology base.","question_ids":["2B.8","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023 as a forward commitment.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz stated the targets as government policy under the National Security Strategy.","limitations":["The commitment was future-dated and the speech does not show execution or results during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5733b3d01d47c51b","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany and its G7 and EU partners were working on long-term security guarantees for Ukraine combining sustained military support with stronger Ukrainian economic resilience, while coordinating with the United States to prevent escalation into a Russia-NATO war.","question_ids":["1B.8","2B.5","2B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz described Germany's diplomatic and security policy.","limitations":["The source reports objectives and coordination, not a completed agreement or measurable outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5733b3d01d47c51b","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany's G7 and EU approach to China combined constructive relations with opposition to coercive changes in the status quo, concern about human rights and rule of law, targeted de-risking, diversified supply chains, and incentives for strategic reserves of critical raw materials.","question_ids":["1B.6","1B.9","5B.3","5B.4","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz described positions adopted or pursued by Germany and its partners.","limitations":["The speech does not establish enforcement, implementation, or measurable reduction of exposure."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5733b3d01d47c51b","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany supported an EU asylum-system compromise combining responsibility at external borders with solidarity, faster determination of protection status, rapid border procedures for applicants with low prospects, registration and continued procedures for those with strong protection claims, and financial contributions from non-participating states.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.3","6B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the speech concerned a compromise not yet finally enacted.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz stated that he would defend and further develop the compromise on behalf of Germany.","limitations":["The source contains the government's rationale but no independent evidence about fairness, implementation, or effects on vulnerable groups."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f83e84543306f1e6","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"The document repeats Scholz's 22 June 2023 statement that Germany adopted its first National Security Strategy, set goals for Ukraine support and NATO defence, approved Arrow 3 and IRIS-T procurement, reported €16.8 billion in aid to Ukraine, and committed to 2% of GDP defence spending from 2024.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.10","2B.5","2B.8","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz attributed the decisions and commitments to his government.","limitations":["This is a duplicate publication of SRC-5733b3d01d47c51b; it adds no independent corroboration."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5b30bf90cb5f6629","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"A January 2023 ZEIT article reported that Scholz had published two substantial essays within weeks, one on respect and one in Foreign Affairs on the global Zeitenwende, and characterized him as presenting himself through these texts as an intellectual and conceptual leader.","question_ids":["8B.1"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The article describes Scholz's published essays and public self-presentation.","limitations":["The supplied extract contains commentary about the essays rather than concrete enacted policy or outcome evidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b76f72e6bda87c15","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"On 29 March 2023, Scholz said the government had introduced numerous modernization laws and would accelerate planning and approvals for rail, roads, bridges, energy networks, electrolysers, solar and wind facilities, and adapt the Federal Immission Control Act.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz described the government's legislative programme and prepared decisions.","limitations":["The speech does not establish enacted final laws, completed projects, or realized economic effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b76f72e6bda87c15","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz reaffirmed a target of 15 million electric vehicles by the end of the decade and said the government had made further decisions concerning technology-neutral transport transition, e-fuels, and hydrogen.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz stated the target and government decisions.","limitations":["The source provides no 2023 progress indicator or independent assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b76f72e6bda87c15","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz said the government had put forward a skilled-worker immigration law intended to attract workers from inside and outside the EU and support future economic growth.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.4","5B.6","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz stated that the government had initiated the legislation on 29 March 2023.","limitations":["The extract does not show enactment, implementation, uptake, or labour-market effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-60b301c8d43d103d","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"On 14 May 2023, Scholz said Germany had received more than one million Ukrainian citizens and pledged continued humanitarian, economic, and military support for Ukraine and its path toward the European Union.","question_ids":["2B.5","3B.7","6B.3","6B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the reception figure refers to the cumulative period since the invasion.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz reported the reception figure and made the support commitment on behalf of Germany.","limitations":["The speech does not provide detailed service-access, distribution, or integration outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0a2e6ea219806e61","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"On 4 December 2023, Scholz said Germany and Brazil had agreed a partnership for a socially just and ecological transformation, while supporting expanded trade, climate cooperation, anti-poverty efforts, and a rules-based multilateral order.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.4","5B.8","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz announced the bilateral partnership and the stated cooperation objectives.","limitations":["The speech does not specify the partnership's binding instruments, funding, implementation, or results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0a2e6ea219806e61","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz stated that Germany's share of renewables in electricity production had risen from just over 40% to about 60% over the previous two years, and that Germany and Brazil aimed to triple global renewable-energy expansion and double energy efficiency by 2030.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.7","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023, with the comparison covering approximately 2021-2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz presented the German figure and endorsed the international targets.","limitations":["The speech does not provide the underlying dataset or establish Scholz's causal contribution to the increase."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0a2e6ea219806e61","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany had broadened its supply chains and energy supply after Russia's attack, agreed with network operators on a hydrogen-core network intended to connect all industrial centres with ports and power plants by 2032, and sought fairer local value creation in raw-material processing.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.4","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz described government objectives and the agreement with network operators.","limitations":["The 2032 network is a future target and the speech does not establish completed diversification or distributional effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0a2e6ea219806e61","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz urged completion of the EU-Mercosur trade agreement, describing a prospective free-trade area of about 780 million people and linking it to open markets, fair standards, jobs, and rules-based trade.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.6","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the agreement remained a negotiation and advocacy objective in the supplied text.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz publicly advocated German and EU support for completing the agreement.","limitations":["The source does not show completion, implementation, or effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-559844caef3ec53b","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"At the ECB's 25th anniversary in May 2023, Scholz publicly endorsed the ECB's independence and anti-inflation efforts, while calling for fiscal policy adjustment to limit inflationary pressure and continued work on the capital-markets and banking unions.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.3","5B.7","5B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz stated his government's support for ECB independence and European fiscal and financial-institutional cooperation.","limitations":["The speech does not establish the government's specific fiscal measures or their effects on inflation and distribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9ede3ee6f2f4b1a1","start_unit":10,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"A July 2023 Foreign Policy analysis reported that Scholz had overridden several ministers to approve a COSCO stake in Hamburg port, had maintained a business-oriented China policy, and that Germany's new China strategy called for supply-chain diversification, investment screening, export controls, and countering Chinese disinformation while warning that implementation remained unproven.","question_ids":["1B.6","1B.9","4B.4","5B.5","5B.7","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023, though some reported actions predated the target year.","ruler_attribution":"The analysis attributed the decision and policy direction to Scholz and his Chancellery.","limitations":["The article is secondary analysis and includes unattributed or interpretive claims; the supplied extract does not establish the full decision record or later implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9ede3ee6f2f4b1a1","start_unit":12,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"The Foreign Policy analysis reported that Germany entered recession in the first quarter of 2023, faced energy-intensive-industry pressure after the loss of cheap Russian gas, and saw large firms shifting investment abroad amid U.S. green subsidies.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The article presented these as contextual constraints on Scholz's government.","limitations":["The extract does not establish Scholz's responsibility for the macroeconomic conditions or quantify policy effects."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-a1a3244a464b1705","SRC-6573e31b005bde40"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied corpus consists largely of speeches and media-page extracts; it provides limited independent evidence about implementation, audits, outcomes, and correction during 2023.","The two June 2023 government-statement URLs contain duplicate text and were treated as separate source records but not as independent corroboration.","Several documents concern 2022 or earlier and are included only where they establish a programme, commitment, or inherited posture materially relevant to 2023."]}
